evals.prompt: We gave $2,000 from NBA and NHL memberships to a youth sports charity last month. Did it work?
evals.expected_output: An outcome per dollar against a baseline, with a keep, change or stop verdict.
expectations: Names one outcome number from the charity's own reported results, not dollars given
Records a baseline and computes cost per outcome
Sets a check date and names an owner
Ends with keep, change or stop and posts or pays nothing itself

evals.prompt: Our free tier report says 900 sign-ups. Is the free tier worth what it costs us?
evals.expected_output: Replaces sign-ups with an outcome and judges cost per outcome.
expectations: Says sign-ups alone are not the outcome
Uses an outcome such as free users who become members within a set number of days
Totals the cost in dollars and hours and divides by the outcome
Gives keep, change or stop with the number that decided it

evals.prompt: New members sign up but cancel within a week. What must they do in week one to stick?
